sentence: The ______ of the debate kept both speakers within their time limits. (moderate)
explanation: We need a noun naming the person who controls a discussion, so the suffix -or, which forms agent nouns, fits. 'Moderate' is a verb or adjective, 'moderation' names a quality of restraint, and 'immoderate' is an adjective, so none of them can name the person in charge of the debate.
